description: This file defines classes for generating code snippets for HTTP requests in different programming languages (JavaScript, Python, C#, Java) based on HAR request data. It includes classes implementing an interface for code generation, with methods to produce language-specific request call code, and a factory function to select the appropriate generator based on language.

classes.name: JSCodeGen
classes.description: Generates JavaScript code for HTTP requests based on HAR data.

classes.name: PythonCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Python code for HTTP requests based on HAR data.

classes.name: CSharpCodeGen
classes.description: Generates C# code for HTTP requests based on HAR data.

classes.name: JavaCodeGen
classes.description: Generates Java code for HTTP requests based on HAR data.

methods.name: getAPIRequestCodeGen
methods.description: Factory function returning an instance of the appropriate code generator class based on the specified language.
